main.summary: Binary envelope used to frame transfer metadata bytes, payload bytes, and optional trailer bytes.

field.name: MediaType
field.summary: Custom media type for transfer envelope bodies.

field.name: Magic
field.summary: Big-endian magic value for the ASCII bytes of "KDSG".

method.name: HasEnvelope
method.summary: Determine whether a byte array begins with the transfer envelope magic value.
method.param: Input byte array.
method.returns: True when the input has a valid envelope magic prefix.

method.name: ParseHeader
method.summary: Parse and validate the fixed transfer envelope header.
method.param: Input byte array containing an envelope.
method.returns: Parsed header when valid; otherwise null.

method.name: GetMetadataBytes
method.summary: Return the metadata region of a transfer envelope without copying.
method.param: Input byte array containing an envelope.
method.returns: Metadata region when valid; otherwise an empty memory block.

method.name: UnwrapPayload
method.summary: Return the payload region of a transfer envelope without copying.
method.param: Input byte array containing an envelope.
method.returns: Payload region when valid; otherwise an empty memory block.

method.name: GetTrailerBytes
method.summary: Return the trailer region of a transfer envelope without copying.
method.param: Input byte array containing an envelope.
method.returns: Trailer region when valid; otherwise an empty memory block.

method.name: ReadHeaderAsync
method.summary: Read and validate the fixed transfer envelope header from a stream.
method.param: Input stream positioned at the start of an envelope.
Cancellation Token.
method.returns: A task-like value that completes with the parsed header when valid; otherwise null.

method.name: ReadMetadataBytesAsync
method.summary: Read the metadata byte region for a previously parsed transfer envelope header.
method.param: Input stream positioned at the metadata region.
Previously parsed envelope header.
Cancellation Token.
method.returns: A task-like value that completes with the metadata bytes when fully available; otherwise an empty memory block.

method.name: ReadTrailerBytesAsync
method.summary: Read the trailer byte region for a previously parsed transfer envelope header.
method.param: Input stream positioned at the trailer region.
Previously parsed envelope header.
Cancellation Token.
method.returns: A task-like value that completes with the trailer bytes when fully available; otherwise an empty memory block.

method.name: OpenPayloadStream
method.summary: Open a bounded payload stream over the remaining payload bytes for a previously parsed transfer envelope header.
method.param: Input stream positioned at the start of the payload region.
Previously parsed envelope header.
True to leave the underlying input stream open when the bounded payload wrapper is disposed.
method.returns: A bounded read-only stream for the payload region.

method.name: WriteAsync
method.summary: Write a transfer envelope to a stream using metadata bytes followed by streamed payload bytes.
method.param: Destination stream that receives the envelope.
Metadata bytes to write after the fixed header.
Readable payload stream positioned at the first payload byte.
Number of payload bytes to write from the payload stream.
Trailer byte length to declare in the envelope header without writing trailer bytes.
Cancellation Token.
method.returns: A task-like value that completes when the envelope has been written.

method.name: WriteWithTrailer
method.summary: Write a transfer envelope to a stream using streamed payload bytes followed by trailer bytes.
method.param: Destination stream that receives the envelope.
Trailer bytes to write after the payload region.
Readable payload stream positioned at the first payload byte.
Number of payload bytes to write from the payload stream.
Cancellation Token.
method.returns: A task-like value that completes when the envelope payload and trailing trailer bytes have been written.

method.name: TryParseHeaderCore
method.summary: Parse the fixed transfer envelope header with optional full-envelope length validation.
method.param: Input bytes containing at least the fixed header.
True to require that the input also contains the declared metadata, payload, and trailer bytes.
Parsed header value when the method succeeds.
method.returns: True when the fixed header is valid; otherwise false.

method.name: GetMetadataOffset
method.summary: Get the byte offset where metadata begins within a transfer envelope.

method.name: GetPayloadOffset
method.summary: Get the byte offset where payload begins for a parsed transfer envelope header.
method.param: Parsed envelope header.

method.name: GetTrailerOffset
method.summary: Get the byte offset where trailer bytes begin for a parsed transfer envelope header.
method.param: Parsed envelope header.

method.name: BuildHeader
method.summary: Build the fixed transfer envelope header bytes.
method.param: Metadata byte length.
Payload byte length.
Trailer byte length.
Envelope flags.
Reserved future-use field distinct from trailer length.

method.name: ComputeEnvelopeLength
method.summary: Compute the total envelope byte length from metadata, payload, and trailer lengths.
method.param: Metadata byte length.
Payload byte length.
Trailer byte length.

method.name: ReadExactlyAsync
method.summary: Read the requested number of bytes from a stream unless the end of the stream is reached first.
method.param: Input stream to read.
Destination buffer that must be completely filled.
Cancellation Token.
method.returns: A task-like value that completes with true when the full buffer was read; otherwise false.
